store.name: Jan's Store
store.author: Jan
store.description: Dynaframe Plugins made by AI - Please note: I used AI exclusively to create this; I am not a coder and cannot check the code for potential vulnerabilities.

packs.title: Playlist Button
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: GPIO button to select playlists via an overlay menu

packs.title: Web Page Button
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: GPIO button that opens a web page full screen on top of the slideshow and closes it again with the next press

packs.title: Jellyfin Now Playing
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Shows what a chosen Jellyfin user is watching or listening to, on the whole screen, for as long as it plays: cover, backdrop, title, episode, year, genres, plot and progress. Installs the plugin together with its scene. All settings on its own plugin page, in German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: Fußball Live
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Live scores, matchdays and tables for Bundesliga, Champions League, English, Scottish and Spanish leagues and cups, the World Cup and more. Installs the plugin together with its scene and can show it over the running playlist every few minutes. Pick your club to show its crest in the background and its colours as accent. English, German or Spanish.

packs.title: American Football Live
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Live scores, weeks and standings for the NFL, College Football (Top 25, SEC, Big Ten, Big 12, ACC), UFL and CFL. Installs the plugin together with its scene and can show it over the running playlist every few minutes or on a touchdown. Pick your team to show its logo in the background and its colours as accent. English, German or Spanish.

packs.title: World Map Live
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: A calm world map with borders, day and night and the day-night line that shows real aircraft, ships, lightning strikes and the ISS live: aircraft from the OpenSky Network (no account needed), ships from up to five sources you can switch on and off (AISStream.io with a free API key, Kystverket for Norway and Digitraffic for the Baltic Sea without sign-up, AISHub, or your own AIS receiver), lightning from the volunteer network Blitzortung.org, the ISS orbit from CelesTrak. Whole world or Europe, DACH, North America, South America, East Asia, Australia and Oceania. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: Biathlon Live
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Biathlon results with shooting, live standings during a race, schedule, next venue and World Cup standings from the IBU (biathlonresults.com): World Cup, World Championships, IBU Cup and more. A rebuild of the MagicMirror module MMM-Biathlon by 2hdlockness. Installs the plugin together with its scene and can show it over the running playlist every few minutes, at race start or when a result is in. Pick your nation to highlight its athletes. English, German or Spanish.

packs.title: Travel Map
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: A world map in the style of an old globe, studded with push pins where your photos were taken. The places come from the photos' GPS data: a DynaFrame playlist, the whole DynaFrame media library (plus extra folders such as a mounted NAS) or your Immich server (all photos or an album). Every collection gets its own pin colour and shape (push pin, thumbtack, flag, long pin); close pins are merged. The pins go in one by one in the order the photos were taken, then a photo is shown at its pin now and then with place and date. Oval world map or three globes, or only the area with pins. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: Foto Cast
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Show the photo or video you are looking at on your phone on the frame right away, on iPhone and Android without an extra app: from the share menu of the Photos app or WhatsApp (iPhone shortcut), from an Android share app, or from the frame's phone page (QR code). Photos fill the screen for a few minutes, videos play once with sound, several take turns, then your playlist carries on. Phones pair once with a code shown on the frame, so nobody else on the Wi-Fi can send. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: YouTube Cast
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Cast YouTube videos from your phone to the frame, like to a TV: tap the cast button in the YouTube app and choose the frame (Android and iPhone, on the same Wi-Fi or once linked with a TV code). The app becomes the remote for pause, seek and volume. Links can also be sent from a phone page or the iPhone share menu. Afterwards your playlist carries on. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: Dynaframe's Magic Mirror
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Inspired by MagicMirror² (github.com/MagicMirrorOrg/MagicMirror); not an official MagicMirror² project. Pick modules and place each one top, bottom, left, right or centre. Or switch the whole scene to a skin (Retro LCD clock, Colour grid, or add-on skins from the catalog, the store or a ZIP file) and choose what each of its fields shows. More modules (Guest Wi-Fi QR, WebUntis, Music Assistant, Jellyfin, river level) from the built-in module catalog. Build your own or port MagicMirror² modules, also with an AI: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Magic Mirror module: Home Assistant
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Module for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror 0.7.0 or newer (install that first). Everything from Home Assistant in one module, one view per spot: values of any entities, house status (only open windows, unlocked locks, alarms, low batteries), climate per room, who is home and bin collection (also from an ICS link). Enter address and token only once. Not an official Home Assistant product. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building or porting modules: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Magic Mirror module: River level
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Module for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror (install that first). Water level of a gauge on German federal waterways (PEGELONLINE) with trend. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building or porting modules: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Magic Mirror module: Guest Wi-Fi
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Module for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror (install that first). Network name, password and a QR code guests scan to join your Wi-Fi. Inspired by MMM-WiFiPassword. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building or porting modules: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Magic Mirror module: WebUntis timetable
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Module for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror (install that first). Next school days with substitutions and cancellations, exams, homework and messages from WebUntis. Inspired by MMM-Webuntis; not an official Untis product. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building or porting modules: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Magic Mirror module: Music Assistant
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Module for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror (install that first). What's playing on your Music Assistant server with cover, progress and up next. Inspired by MMM-MusicAssistant. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building or porting modules: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Magic Mirror module: Jellyfin now playing
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Module for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror (install that first). What's playing on your Jellyfin server: music, movie, episode or live TV with cover, progress and up next. Not an official Jellyfin product. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building or porting modules: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Magic Mirror module: Travel time
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Module for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror (install that first). How long the drive takes right now: traffic delay, distance, road, alternative route and "Leave by" for an arrival time, plus incidents and closures on German motorways along the route. Uses your own Mapbox key (10,000 requests a month free without a payment method) or Google Routes API key. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building or porting modules: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Magic Mirror skin: Starship console
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Skin for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror 0.6.3 or newer (install that first). Black screen with rounded orange, lilac and peach bars like the ship computers of 90s starship series: big clock, stardate, main viewer for up to three items, three readouts and a bottom line. Choose on the plugin page what each field shows (forecast, news, calendar, departures, Home Assistant values …). Text size adjustable per field. Three colour sets incl. red alert. A fan design, not an official product. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building skins: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md#skins

packs.title: Settings Backup
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Saves the settings of all your plugins and scenes to one file and puts them back, on this frame or on another one. Missing stores are added and missing packs installed from the stores they came from, plugins without a store travel with their code, and settings take effect right away. With a password the file is encrypted and also carries API keys and passwords; without one they are left out. Every restore can be undone. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: Immich Slideshow
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Photos from your own Immich server in DynaFrame's slideshow, with DynaFrame's own display time and transitions: pick albums or all photos, narrow down by stars, favourites, people or a free search, random order without repeats or by date. The photos stay on the server; only the next few are kept on the frame and swapped once shown. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: Network Overview
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Your home network as a living map: which devices are online (LAN, Wi-Fi, guests), internet speed and today's data volume from your FRITZ!Box, queries and blocked ads from up to three Pi-holes (keepalived pairs are recognised), and storage, disk temperatures, CPU, RAM and containers from your Unraid server (7.2 or later, or any server with Glances). The plugin keeps a short history and points out what stands out today: a new device, a hot disk, a Pi-hole that does not answer, more blocked or downloaded than usual. Everything stays in your home network. German, English or Spanish.

packs.title: Magic Mirror module: Fuel prices
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Module for Dynaframe's Magic Mirror (install that first). The cheapest petrol stations near you for Super E5, Super E10 and diesel with real-time prices, and whether now is a good time to fill up: comparison with the average, the last 24 hours as a small chart and the time of day when fuel is usually cheapest (the module learns this itself). Germany only, needs a free Tankerkönig API key. Does not appear under Plugins. Guide for building or porting modules: https://github.com/Archonw/Jans-DynaframePro-Store/blob/main/plugin_packs/magic-frame/MODULES.md

packs.title: Web Login
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Puts a login in front of the frame's web page: a password, single sign-on with your own OIDC provider, or both, optionally over HTTPS. Also closes the ports that lead past the login to everyone but the frame itself and devices you trust, such as Home Assistant, or apps with an API key (HTTPS only by default); ports of other plugins stay open unless you tick them. The frame, its scenes and NFC readers keep working, and the login comes back on its own after a DynaFrame update. German, English or Spanish. Please note: SSH, file shares, other plugins' ports (unless ticked) and UDP services are not covered; never expose the frame to the internet. Test thoroughly yourself whether it gives enough protection for your setup. Provided as is, without warranty, at your own risk.

packs.title: Ticker Wall
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Turn the frame into a news-channel and trading-floor wall: news feeds, stock prices, crypto, currencies, world clocks, weather and earthquakes, all scrolling at once. Far too much to follow, and that's the point. Ticker Wall also analyses the headlines: a topic radar of what many sources report right now, breaking-news detection, the news pace of the day and a market mood gauge with gainers and losers. Optional alerts bring the wall over the playlist: keywords in the news, breaking news, price rules (NVDA > 150, TSLA ± 5%), big index moves, market opening bells and strong earthquakes. Two looks (news channel or trading terminal), landscape and portrait, region presets for the US, UK, Germany, Spain or international. Free sources; stock prices need a free Finnhub key. Installs the plugin together with its scene. English, German or Spanish.

packs.title: Halloween Scare
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: This pack is a demo: it shows how a plugin can react to triggers from Home Assistant (motion sensors, doorbells, switches, events) and take over the screen for a moment. Halloween is just the example. A Halloween jump scare for your frame. It shows your photos as usual until a motion sensor or the doorbell in your Home Assistant goes off. Then one of four scares comes over the playlist: a haunted portrait whose eyes find you before it turns into a screaming ghoul, a pale ghost standing in the photo that is on screen right now before it jumps at you, the picture breaking up like an old TV while a dark figure comes closer with every glitch, or a monster grabbing the edge of the frame and roaring "Trick or treat!". Every scare has a gentle version for children. The frame plays the screams and noises itself, right on cue, and sets the volume back afterwards. Pause between scares, chance per trigger, quiet hours, "only around Halloween" and an arm switch; Home Assistant automations can start a scare with the halloween_scare event. All pictures and sounds are made by the plugin itself. Installs the plugin together with its scene. English, German or Spanish.

packs.title: Growing Up
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Watch your children (or anyone) grow up on the frame. Growing Up takes people from your own Immich server, picks the best face per month, quarter or year from all their photos and cuts out portraits lined up on the face. The scene plays them as a time-lapse with age and date, as a contact sheet of all years, as then and now, and shows siblings side by side at the same age. On birthdays it can come over the playlist with congratulations. Limit it to chosen albums, star ratings or favourites so nothing private shows. Photos stay on your Immich server; the frame keeps only the small portraits. Installs the plugin together with its scene. English, German or Spanish.

packs.title: Foto Mosaik
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: One of your photos, rebuilt from hundreds of your own photos as small tiles, matched by colour. The tiles settle over the picture in a wave, then the camera glides slowly towards a single tile, which turns into the real photo with its date and place, and finally the mosaic fades back to the original. In the endless flow the camera dives into the tile until it fills the screen, and that photo becomes the next mosaic. Tiles and motifs come from a DynaFrame playlist, the whole DynaFrame library or an Immich server (all photos or an album), and can come from different sources. The plugin prepares the tiles once in the background and caches them, so playback stays light on the Pi. Tile size, tint, pace and captions can be set on the plugin page. Installs the plugin together with its scene. English, German or Spanish.

packs.title: On This Day
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Your photos of this day in earlier years, shown as a journey through time. Next to every photo you see the weather back then at that very place and hour (from the photo's date, time and GPS, via the free Open-Meteo archive back to 1940) and the weather today, with how much warmer or colder it was. A timeline shows the temperature of every year. After the last year a summary shows one photo per year, the temperatures of all years next to today's, the warmest, coldest and wettest year and the place you were most often on this day. Two views: time travel (one photo after another with slow zoom) or side by side (all years as photo cards). Photo duration, transition, photos per year and the days around today are adjustable. The photos come from a DynaFrame playlist, the whole DynaFrame library or an Immich server (all photos or an album), with Immich filters for albums, stars, favourites and archived photos. Installs the plugin together with its scene. English, German or Spanish.

packs.title: Colour Calendar
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Your year as a calendar of colours. Every day becomes a cell in the colour of the photos you took that day, so summers, holidays, winters and Christmas show up as a band of colour. The photos come from a DynaFrame playlist, the whole DynaFrame media library (WebDAV too, plus extra folders) or your Immich server (all photos or chosen albums; Immich's ThumbHash gives the colours without downloading a single image). Immich photos can be filtered by stars, favourites and archive; hidden and locked photos never show. Four shapes: months, weeks like a wall planner, a ring (several years as rings inside each other) or stripes with one band per year. Last 12 months, this year, a year of your choice or several years; dark or light, squares or dots, vivid colours and the colour of each month. Now and then a day lights up and slowly scrolls through its photos, shown whole and uncropped, side by side or one above the other (you choose how many photos or how long, and how fast), with the date and its colours: at random, day by day or this day in earlier years. Installs the plugin together with its scene. English, German or Spanish.

packs.title: Playlist Music
packs.author: Jan
packs.description: Plays music while certain playlists are running, each playlist with its own music: internet radio, your own stream, Jellyfin, a folder on the frame, Spotify (Premium; the frame becomes a Spotify Connect speaker, pairing by code, no developer key) or Music Assistant (e.g. YouTube Music), or music from the time of the photos (the next ones in the real order, also when shuffled, or the last ones): radio from that decade, your own songs from those years (Jellyfin, Spotify liked songs) or a matching hits playlist. Plays on the frame or on another speaker (Spotify Connect devices, Music Assistant speakers such as Sonos). Fades in and out or keeps playing, pauses or gets quieter for videos and when another plugin shows something, doesn't start if music is already playing, only at the times you choose. German, English or Spanish.
